title: Bad monotone-selection condition
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function from length-$n$ sign vectors to signs, let $t$ be a positive rational influence bound, let $\varepsilon$ be a rational with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, and let $J$ be a set of coordinates. The selection is bad if either the set of coordinates whose influence under $f$ is at least the learning threshold for $t,\varepsilon$ is not contained in $J$, or the cardinality of $J$ exceeds the coordinate cap for $t,\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps length-$n$ sign vectors to signs
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates
